title: Best Buy to debut on TikTok Shop, introducing new way for customers to discover and shop
summary: One of the first big-box retailers on the platform, Best Buy will bring nearly 10,000 products to TikTok Shop beginning in late October.
body_markdown:
By[Best Buy](https://corporate.bestbuy.com/)


September 22, 2026


## One of the first big-box retailers on the platform, Best Buy will bring


nearly 10,000


products to TikTok Shop beginning in late October


**Key Highlights**


- In late October, Best Buy is launching on TikTok Shop, allowing customers to discover and shop directly through the platform.
- Best Buy’s TikTok Shop will have a selection of nearly 10,000 products well suited to social discovery, like headphones, cameras, small appliances, laptops and accessories.
- Customers can browse products through shoppable videos, the Best Buy shop page, the shop tab and in-app product pages.
- TikTok creators can bring products to life through shoppable videos and photos.


Best Buy is launching on


[TikTok Shop](https://www.tiktok.com/@bestbuy?lang=en) , giving customers a new way to discover and shop for technology, right from their feed to their front door. Starting in late October, the experience will feature nearly 10,000 products from top brands including Oura, Bose, Dyson and Microsoft, enabling customers to go from discovery to purchase without leaving the TikTok app.


“Social media isn’t just influencing what people buy anymore. It’s shaping how they discover products, with creators playing an increasingly important role in what people notice, consider and want to try,” said Jonathan Greer, vice president of e-commerce at Best Buy. “Launching on TikTok Shop lets us meet customers at that exact moment of discovery and make it easy to shop.”


### A new way to shop Best Buy


With the launch of TikTok Shop, customers will have another way to shop with Best Buy just in time for the holiday season. App users can expect to see products through shoppable creator videos, the Best Buy shop page, the TikTok Shop tab and product pages in the app. Customers can purchase products directly through TikTok, with orders fulfilled by Best Buy. Eligible TikTok Shop purchases can be returned directly in store or mailed back to Best Buy, making returns easy and convenient.


### Powering creator-led commerce


The launch also gives creators and brands more ways to connect with their audiences. Through the


[Best Buy Creator program](https://corporate.bestbuy.com/2025/best-buy-creator-program/) , creators can share their expertise, introduce followers to products and let them shop directly in the TikTok app.


For Best Buy Ads partners, the launch unlocks new ways to work with creators on the platform. Brands can use creator content in their campaigns to feature products, give shoppers a direct path to purchase through shoppable content and affiliate links, and extend the reach of the content through paid advertising. Campaigns connect back to Best Buy’s first-party data and measurement capabilities so brands can better understand which creators, content and products are driving engagement and sales.
